e.title: AWS Insurance Underwriting GenAI
e.summary: AWS 官方核保 GenAI 参考架构（20★，MIT-0）：Bedrock + Step Functions 的核保验证 RAG（核保手册文档问答）
e.summary_en: AWS official underwriting GenAI reference (20★, MIT-0): Bedrock + Step Functions underwriting-validation RAG (underwriting manual document Q&A)
e.summary_hk: AWS 官方核保 GenAI 參考架構（20★，MIT-0）：Bedrock + Step Functions 的核保驗證 RAG（核保手冊文檔問答）
e.body: AWS Insurance Underwriting GenAI（AWS 官方 samples，20★，MIT-0）是用生成式 AI 简化保险核保的参考架构：Amazon Bedrock + AWS Step Functions 的核保验证流程 + RAG（上传核保手册文档后做问答）——配套 AWS 博客（streamline insurance underwriting with generative AI using Amazon Bedrock）。对 RIAA：保险核保 AI 的官方参考——[[credibility-gated-xai]]（核保 XAI 框架）的工程架构层；RAG 核保手册问答（[[valact-rag]] 核保应用）；AWS 服务编排（Step Functions/Lambda/EventBridge）；与 [[hcls-agent-skills]]（AWS 医疗技能）、[[insurance-support-agent]]（核保 agent）配套；适合保险核保 AI 与云架构方向。
e.body_en: AWS Insurance Underwriting GenAI (AWS official samples, 20★, MIT-0) is a reference architecture for streamlining insurance underwriting with generative AI: underwriting validation with Amazon Bedrock + AWS Step Functions + RAG (upload the underwriting manual and do document Q&A) — companion of the AWS blog 'streamline insurance underwriting with generative AI using Amazon Bedrock'. For RIAA: the official reference for insurance underwriting AI — the engineering-architecture layer of [[credibility-gated-xai]] (underwriting XAI framework); RAG over underwriting manuals (the underwriting application of [[valact-rag]]); AWS service orchestration (Step Functions/Lambda/EventBridge); pairs with [[hcls-agent-skills]] (AWS healthcare skills) and [[insurance-support-agent]] (underwriting agents); suits insurance underwriting AI and cloud architecture.
e.body_hk: AWS Insurance Underwriting GenAI（AWS 官方 samples，20★，MIT-0）是用生成式 AI 簡化保險核保的參考架構：Amazon Bedrock + AWS Step Functions 的核保驗證流程 + RAG（上傳核保手冊文檔後做問答）——配套 AWS 博客（streamline insurance underwriting with generative AI using Amazon Bedrock）。對 RIAA：保險核保 AI 的官方參考——[[credibility-gated-xai]]（核保 XAI 框架）的工程架構層；RAG 核保手冊問答（[[valact-rag]] 核保應用）；AWS 服務編排（Step Functions/Lambda/EventBridge）；與 [[hcls-agent-skills]]（AWS 醫療技能）、[[insurance-support-agent]]（核保 agent）配套；適合保險核保 AI 與雲架構方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：AWS 官方 samples（Bedrock 核保 RAG 架构），未实测
